AbortSignal.timeout()

The AbortSignal.timeout() static method returns a signal that aborts after a given time. See AbortSignal and the Fetch standard. A fragment link and a script link keep only their text.

Syntax

const signal = AbortSignal.timeout(5000);
const response = await fetch(url, { signal });
if (a < b && c) { retry(); }

Parameters

  • time: milliseconds before the abort
  • Nested lists work:
    1. first
    2. second
BrowserVersion
Chrome103
Firefox100 | ESR

Note: the timeout counts active time only.
